items.title: Chandrayaan programme
items.snippet_en: The Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully landed on the Moon on August 23, 2023. India became the first nation to successfully land a spacecraft in the lunar south pole region, and the fourth country to land on the Moon after the Soviet Union, the United States, and China.

items.title: Chandrayaan-3
items.snippet_en: Chandrayaan-3 touched down near the lunar south pole, at 69°S, on August 23, 2023, at 18:04 IST (12:33 UTC). ISRO became the fourth national space agency to successfully land on the Moon and the first in human history to achieve a soft landing near the lunar south pole.

items.title: India becomes only the 4th country to successfully land a spacecraft on the moon
items.snippet_en: India landed a spacecraft near the moon's south pole on August 23, 2023, becoming the first country to touch down near the little-explored south pole region. This also made India the fourth country to achieve a moon landing.

items.title: India lands spacecraft near south pole of moon in historic first
items.snippet_en: India became the first country to successfully land a spacecraft near the south pole of the moon on August 23, 2023. The Vikram lander touched down shortly after 6 pm India time (12:30 BST) near the lunar south pole.

items.title: India Becomes First Nation to Land Craft on Moon's South Pole
items.snippet_en: India successfully placed a lander in the moon's southern polar region on August 23, 2023, making it the first country to touch down on an uncharted part of the lunar surface. No country had previously made a soft landing on the more challenging rough terrain of the south pole.

items.title: Chandrayaan-3: Historic India mission for moon's south pole set for landing
items.snippet_en: Chandrayaan-3 was scheduled to touch down shortly after 6 pm India time (12:30 GMT) on August 23, 2023, near the lunar south pole. India could become the first nation to land a spacecraft on the moon's south pole.
